tagline.zh: 依次与观战嘉宾队列进行猜拳，争夺最长连胜纪录。在有限情报与游说机制下博弈，连胜中断仍须打完全程。
tagline.en: Face a shared gauntlet of studio guests in Rock-Paper-Scissors to build the longest unbroken winning streak. Lobby guests, read tells, and manage your streak risk.

rulesBrief.zh: 依次与观战嘉宾队列进行猜拳，争夺最长连胜纪录。在有限情报与游说机制下博弈，连胜中断仍须打完全程。 胜负条件：Higher longest consecutive winning streak after all 9 guests are played.
rulesBrief.en: Face a shared gauntlet of studio guests in Rock-Paper-Scissors to build the longest unbroken winning streak. Lobby guests, read tells, and manage your streak risk. Win: Higher longest consecutive winning streak after all 9 guests are played.

tagline.zh: 零运气的心理博弈掷柶：每方由主将与搭档组成，4人同时秘密决定投出平面或弧面柶木，4根合成步数（猪必为倒退猪！），先让主将2枚棋子绕完29格棋盘冲线者胜。
tagline.en: Zero-luck strategic Korean Yutnori: all 4 players secretly pick one of two Yut sticks (Flat vs Round) simultaneously—meaning you control half the throw and must outread your rival's half!

rulesBrief.zh: 零运气的心理博弈掷柶：每方由主将与搭档组成，4人同时秘密决定投出平面或弧面柶木，4根合成步数（猪必为倒退猪！），先让主将2枚棋子绕完29格棋盘冲线者胜。 胜负条件：First side to get BOTH of its Candidate Mals past the finish line wins immediately.
rulesBrief.en: Zero-luck strategic Korean Yutnori: all 4 players secretly pick one of two Yut sticks (Flat vs Round) simultaneously—meaning you control half the throw and must outread your rival's half! Win: First side to get BOTH of its Candidate Mals past the finish line wins immediately.

tagline.zh: 《The Genius》最具代表性的心理博弈：双方将1–10数字牌贴于额头，只能看到对手的牌而看不到自己的牌。加注、跟注或弃牌——若拿10弃牌将额外罚给对手10枚筹码！
tagline.en: The signature Genius bluffing battle: you see your opponent's card (1–10) on their forehead, but NOT your own. Bet, raise, or fold—but folding a 10 costs a brutal 10-chip penalty!

rulesBrief.zh: 《The Genius》最具代表性的心理博弈：双方将1–10数字牌贴于额头，只能看到对手的牌而看不到自己的牌。加注、跟注或弃牌——若拿10弃牌将额外罚给对手10枚筹码！ 胜负条件：Reduce opponent's chip stack to 0.
rulesBrief.en: The signature Genius bluffing battle: you see your opponent's card (1–10) on their forehead, but NOT your own. Bet, raise, or fold—but folding a 10 costs a brutal 10-chip penalty! Win: Reduce opponent's chip stack to 0.

tagline.zh: 致命版《只言片语》：两位淘汰候选人轮流出题，为自己的抽象画卡给出提示词，其余5人各混入1张干扰卡后投票。对手猜中则出题者失1石榴石，对手猜错则对手失1石榴石；但若全场全中或全错，出题者重罚2石榴石！
tagline.en: A deadly Dixit-style psychological mind game: give a clue for your surreal art card that fools your rival—but if ALL 5 guessers miss OR all 5 get it right, YOU lose 2 Garnets!

rulesBrief.zh: 致命版《只言片语》：两位淘汰候选人轮流出题，为自己的抽象画卡给出提示词，其余5人各混入1张干扰卡后投票。对手猜中则出题者失1石榴石，对手猜错则对手失1石榴石；但若全场全中或全错，出题者重罚2石榴石！ 胜负条件：First candidate to reduce their rival to 0 Garnets wins.
rulesBrief.en: A deadly Dixit-style psychological mind game: give a clue for your surreal art card that fools your rival—but if ALL 5 guessers miss OR all 5 get it right, YOU lose 2 Garnets! Win: First candidate to reduce their rival to 0 Garnets wins.

tagline.zh: 面对共享的16块字母翻转板（A–P），在自己的20格传送带上寻找眼前图案的对应位置。猜中前进1格并获得连翻机会；猜错则传送带倒退1格并换人。先冲到终点者胜，跌落传送带者立即淘汰！
tagline.en: Race to the front of a 20-tile conveyor belt by locating matching icons behind a shared 4×4 (A–P) flip wall. Hit a match to advance AND keep going; miss and your belt slides backward toward the abyss!

rulesBrief.zh: 面对共享的16块字母翻转板（A–P），在自己的20格传送带上寻找眼前图案的对应位置。猜中前进1格并获得连翻机会；猜错则传送带倒退1格并换人。先冲到终点者胜，跌落传送带者立即淘汰！ 胜负条件：1) First player to reach Slot 20 (Finish Line), OR 2) Opponent falls off the back of their conveyor belt (position ≤ 0).
rulesBrief.en: Race to the front of a 20-tile conveyor belt by locating matching icons behind a shared 4×4 (A–P) flip wall. Hit a match to advance AND keep going; miss and your belt slides backward toward the abyss! Win: 1) First player to reach Slot 20 (Finish Line), OR 2) Opponent falls off the back of their conveyor belt (position ≤ 0).

tagline.zh: 凑齐4张颜色与数字均不相同的“Quattro”且总和更大者胜！采用第4季官方6名虚拟玩家规则（红蓝绿黄1–6共24张+2张黑0牌），在逐步翻开手牌的过程中与6位虚拟玩家各交换1次，精准算牌与规避0牌陷阱。
tagline.en: Build the highest-sum 'Quattro'—4 cards of 4 different colors AND 4 different numbers—by revealing cards one by one and executing mandatory 1-for-1 trades with 6 deterministic Virtual Players.

rulesBrief.zh:
凑齐4张颜色与数字均不相同的“Quattro”且总和更大者胜！采用第4季官方6名虚拟玩家规则（红蓝绿黄1–6共24张+2张黑0牌），在逐步翻开手牌的过程中与6位虚拟玩家各交换1次，精准算牌与规避0牌陷阱。 胜负条件：1) Completing a legal Quattro beats failing to complete a Quattro.
2) If BOTH complete a Quattro: higher sum of the 4 cards wins.
3) If NEITHER completes a Quattro: higher sum of the 4 cards wins.
rulesBrief.en:
Build the highest-sum 'Quattro'—4 cards of 4 different colors AND 4 different numbers—by revealing cards one by one and executing mandatory 1-for-1 trades with 6 deterministic Virtual Players. Win: 1) Completing a legal Quattro beats failing to complete a Quattro.
2) If BOTH complete a Quattro: higher sum of the 4 cards wins.
3) If NEITHER completes a Quattro: higher sum of the 4 cards wins.

tagline.zh: 10个神秘杯子各藏有日、月、星之一。双方初始各4枚筹码：先手下注额不得超过对手筹码的一半，后手则必须下注至少先手2倍的筹码！猜中获得3倍返还（净赚2倍），猜错全失，10轮后筹码多者胜或破产即淘汰。
tagline.en: 10 sealed cups hide Sun, Moon, or Star. The first bettor chooses a symbol and wager (up to half the rival's chips); the second bettor is FORCED to wager AT LEAST DOUBLE that amount on a symbol!

rulesBrief.zh: 10个神秘杯子各藏有日、月、星之一。双方初始各4枚筹码：先手下注额不得超过对手筹码的一半，后手则必须下注至少先手2倍的筹码！猜中获得3倍返还（净赚2倍），猜错全失，10轮后筹码多者胜或破产即淘汰。 胜负条件：1) Opponent busts to 0 chips, OR 2) Have strictly more chips after Round 10.
rulesBrief.en: 10 sealed cups hide Sun, Moon, or Star. The first bettor chooses a symbol and wager (up to half the rival's chips); the second bettor is FORCED to wager AT LEAST DOUBLE that amount on a symbol! Win: 1) Opponent busts to 0 chips, OR 2) Have strictly more chips after Round 10.

tagline.zh: 在3×3共9张几何图块中（3种形状×3种图形色×3种背景色），轮流在10秒内寻找3个属性各自“全同或全异”的3张牌组合喊“合!”（+1分，错-1分）；当场上再无任何“合”时喊“结!”（+3分并结束本局，错-1分）。共10回合，总分高者胜。
tagline.en: Scan a 3×3 grid of 9 geometric tiles (Shape × Shape Color × Background Color) to call 'Hap!' on 3-tile sets where each attribute is all-same or all-different (+1 pt), and shout 'Gyul!' when ZERO sets remain (+3 pts)!

rulesBrief.zh: 在3×3共9张几何图块中（3种形状×3种图形色×3种背景色），轮流在10秒内寻找3个属性各自“全同或全异”的3张牌组合喊“合!”（+1分，错-1分）；当场上再无任何“合”时喊“结!”（+3分并结束本局，错-1分）。共10回合，总分高者胜。 胜负条件：Highest cumulative score after 10 rounds.
rulesBrief.en: Scan a 3×3 grid of 9 geometric tiles (Shape × Shape Color × Background Color) to call 'Hap!' on 3-tile sets where each attribute is all-same or all-different (+1 pt), and shout 'Gyul!' when ZERO sets remain (+3 pts)! Win: Highest cumulative score after 10 rounds.

tagline.zh: 在8×8棋盘上运用激光反射与分光原理消灭对方的“王”！双方各有10枚棋子（1激光炮、1分光器、1王、5三棱镜骑士、2四棱镜骑士）。每回合移动1格或旋转90°，随后己方激光自动发射，击中任何无镜面的一侧即摧毁棋子。
tagline.en: Command mirrors, beam-splitters, and your corner laser cannon on an 8×8 board. Move or rotate 1 piece per turn, then automatically fire your laser—vaporize the enemy King to win!

rulesBrief.zh: 在8×8棋盘上运用激光反射与分光原理消灭对方的“王”！双方各有10枚棋子（1激光炮、1分光器、1王、5三棱镜骑士、2四棱镜骑士）。每回合移动1格或旋转90°，随后己方激光自动发射，击中任何无镜面的一侧即摧毁棋子。 胜负条件：Destroy the opponent's King with a laser beam (yours or theirs!).
rulesBrief.en: Command mirrors, beam-splitters, and your corner laser cannon on an 8×8 board. Move or rotate 1 piece per turn, then automatically fire your laser—vaporize the enemy King to win! Win: Destroy the opponent's King with a laser beam (yours or theirs!).

tagline.zh: 双方各自率领4人小队互换攻守进行4回合“关灯越线”心理战！进攻方秘密决定派几名队员在暗黑中越过红线（同一队员第k次成功越线得k分）；防守方仅有3次按红钮抓捕机会（抓到即淘汰越线者，但空按红钮则罚送进攻方任选1人免费得分），绿钮不限次数。
tagline.en: Command a 4-agent squad in pitch darkness! As Attacker, secretly choose which agents cross the red line for escalating combo points (1→2→3→4 pts). As Defender, press RED to eliminate crossers (only 3 uses!) or GREEN to hold fire—false Red alarms gift a free crossing!

rulesBrief.zh: 双方各自率领4人小队互换攻守进行4回合“关灯越线”心理战！进攻方秘密决定派几名队员在暗黑中越过红线（同一队员第k次成功越线得k分）；防守方仅有3次按红钮抓捕机会（抓到即淘汰越线者，但空按红钮则罚送进攻方任选1人免费得分），绿钮不限次数。 胜负条件：Higher total points after both halves (4 Attack rounds + 4 Defend rounds each).
rulesBrief.en: Command a 4-agent squad in pitch darkness! As Attacker, secretly choose which agents cross the red line for escalating combo points (1→2→3→4 pts). As Defender, press RED to eliminate crossers (only 3 uses!) or GREEN to hold fire—false Red alarms gift a free crossing! Win: Higher total points after both halves (4 Attack rounds + 4 Defend rounds each).

tagline.zh: 印第安扑克与德州扑克的终极融合！40张牌（1–10各4张），每人额头1张暗牌+桌面2张公共牌，组成3张牌型：三条 > 顺子（10与1可相连！）> 对子 > 散牌。若握有顺子或三条弃牌，须额外罚给对手10枚筹码！
tagline.en: Indian Poker meets Texas Hold'em! Combine your hidden forehead card with 2 face-up community cards to form Three-of-a-Kind > Straight (wrap-around 10-1 allowed!) > Pair > High Card—and NEVER fold a Straight or Triple (-10 chip penalty)!

rulesBrief.zh: 印第安扑克与德州扑克的终极融合！40张牌（1–10各4张），每人额头1张暗牌+桌面2张公共牌，组成3张牌型：三条 > 顺子（10与1可相连！）> 对子 > 散牌。若握有顺子或三条弃牌，须额外罚给对手10枚筹码！ 胜负条件：Reduce opponent's chips to 0.
rulesBrief.en: Indian Poker meets Texas Hold'em! Combine your hidden forehead card with 2 face-up community cards to form Three-of-a-Kind > Straight (wrap-around 10-1 allowed!) > Pair > High Card—and NEVER fold a Straight or Triple (-10 chip penalty)! Win: Reduce opponent's chips to 0.

tagline.zh: 双方各有0–8共9张数字砖（偶数0,2,4,6,8为黑，奇数1,3,5,7为白）。每轮由上轮胜者先出，数字全程保密仅公开黑白颜色与当轮胜负！利用黑白线索推理对手残牌，9轮后胜分高者胜（先得5分即锁定胜局）。
tagline.en: Play 9 blind rounds with tiles 0–8 (Even = Black, Odd = White). The numbers played are NEVER revealed—only their Black/White color and who won the round! Deduce your rival's remaining tiles and out-tempo them.

rulesBrief.zh: 双方各有0–8共9张数字砖（偶数0,2,4,6,8为黑，奇数1,3,5,7为白）。每轮由上轮胜者先出，数字全程保密仅公开黑白颜色与当轮胜负！利用黑白线索推理对手残牌，9轮后胜分高者胜（先得5分即锁定胜局）。 胜负条件：More Win Points after 9 rounds (or first to reach an insurmountable lead, e.g. 5 points).
rulesBrief.en: Play 9 blind rounds with tiles 0–8 (Even = Black, Odd = White). The numbers played are NEVER revealed—only their Black/White color and who won the round! Deduce your rival's remaining tiles and out-tempo them. Win: More Win Points after 9 rounds (or first to reach an insurmountable lead, e.g. 5 points).

tagline.zh: 双方各有99点能量，分9回合盲注对决！投入点数保密，但对手可见两大线索：①单数(0–9)亮黑牌、双位数(10+)亮白牌；②5格剩余能量灯（每跌破80/60/40/20/0即熄灭1格，且在确认出价瞬间立即变化）。先得5胜或9轮胜多者胜！
tagline.en: Budget 99 points across 9 blind rounds! Every bid stays secret—revealing ONLY a Black card (0–9) or White card (10+), plus 5 energy lamps that drop off every 20 remaining points. Outsmart your rival's resource math to win 5 rounds!

rulesBrief.zh: 双方各有99点能量，分9回合盲注对决！投入点数保密，但对手可见两大线索：①单数(0–9)亮黑牌、双位数(10+)亮白牌；②5格剩余能量灯（每跌破80/60/40/20/0即熄灭1格，且在确认出价瞬间立即变化）。先得5胜或9轮胜多者胜！ 胜负条件：More Win Points after 9 rounds (or first to insurmountable lead, e.g. 5 wins).
rulesBrief.en: Budget 99 points across 9 blind rounds! Every bid stays secret—revealing ONLY a Black card (0–9) or White card (10+), plus 5 energy lamps that drop off every 20 remaining points. Outsmart your rival's resource math to win 5 rounds! Win: More Win Points after 9 rounds (or first to insurmountable lead, e.g. 5 wins).

tagline.zh: 双方仅持1枚筹码开局，共11回合（8名观战嘉宾+3名手势全公开的虚拟玩家）。每回合先手决定亲自猜拳（赢可得1/2/3/4枚递增筹码）或押注对手胜负（押胜/负中赔2倍、平局退回；押平局中赔3倍！）。11轮后筹码多者胜！
tagline.en: Start with just 1 chip! Each round, the First Player chooses either to PLAY Rock-Paper-Scissors against the round's guest (for escalating 1→4 chip rewards) OR force the rival to play while BETTING on Win (2×), Lose (2×), or Draw (3×)!

rulesBrief.zh: 双方仅持1枚筹码开局，共11回合（8名观战嘉宾+3名手势全公开的虚拟玩家）。每回合先手决定亲自猜拳（赢可得1/2/3/4枚递增筹码）或押注对手胜负（押胜/负中赔2倍、平局退回；押平局中赔3倍！）。11轮后筹码多者胜！ 胜负条件：More chips after Round 11.
rulesBrief.en: Start with just 1 chip! Each round, the First Player chooses either to PLAY Rock-Paper-Scissors against the round's guest (for escalating 1→4 chip rewards) OR force the rival to play while BETTING on Win (2×), Lose (2×), or Draw (3×)! Win: More chips after Round 11.

tagline.zh: 每张双面牌正面公开、背面仅本人可见（第4季规则：正反面必为一奇一偶，1–10）。开局各40枚筹码，下注前锁定押正面或押背面（不可更改），或发动“双面下注”（需下对手2倍筹码）：若己方正反两面均大于对手所选面则大获全胜并额外抢走对手10枚筹码！
tagline.en: Every card has a PUBLIC Front number and a SECRET Back number (opposite parity: odd ↔ even!). Choose to bet on your Front, your Back, or declare a 2× DOUBLE-BET—beat your rival with BOTH sides to steal an extra +10 bonus chips!

rulesBrief.zh: 每张双面牌正面公开、背面仅本人可见（第4季规则：正反面必为一奇一偶，1–10）。开局各40枚筹码，下注前锁定押正面或押背面（不可更改），或发动“双面下注”（需下对手2倍筹码）：若己方正反两面均大于对手所选面则大获全胜并额外抢走对手10枚筹码！ 胜负条件：Reduce opponent's chip stack to 0.
rulesBrief.en: Every card has a PUBLIC Front number and a SECRET Back number (opposite parity: odd ↔ even!). Choose to bet on your Front, your Back, or declare a 2× DOUBLE-BET—beat your rival with BOTH sides to steal an extra +10 bonus chips! Win: Reduce opponent's chip stack to 0.

tagline.zh: 改编自《动物将棋》的3×4极致策略棋！每方4枚棋子（王、将、相、子），吃掉敌子可俘虏并在己方回合空降重用（不可空降到敌方底线3格）。“子”冲入敌阵升变为“侯”。吃掉敌王或己方王闯入敌阵并挺过对手1回合即获胜！三局两胜制。
tagline.en: Deceptively deep micro-chess on a 3×4 board! Capture enemy pieces to drop them back as your own soldiers, promote your Pawn (子) into a Feudal Lord (侯), and win by capturing the enemy King (王) OR surviving 1 full turn with your King inside enemy territory!

rulesBrief.zh: 改编自《动物将棋》的3×4极致策略棋！每方4枚棋子（王、将、相、子），吃掉敌子可俘虏并在己方回合空降重用（不可空降到敌方底线3格）。“子”冲入敌阵升变为“侯”。吃掉敌王或己方王闯入敌阵并挺过对手1回合即获胜！三局两胜制。 胜负条件：Win a single game by: 1) Capturing opponent's King (王), 2) Your King enters enemy Territory and survives 1 turn (Try Rule), or 3) Opponent times out. Win the Death Match by winning 2 games (Best-of-3).
rulesBrief.en: Deceptively deep micro-chess on a 3×4 board! Capture enemy pieces to drop them back as your own soldiers, promote your Pawn (子) into a Feudal Lord (侯), and win by capturing the enemy King (王) OR surviving 1 full turn with your King inside enemy territory! Win: Win a single game by: 1) Capturing opponent's King (王), 2) Your King enters enemy Territory and survives 1 turn (Try Rule), or 3) Opponent times out. Win the Death Match by winning 2 games (Best-of-3).

tagline.zh: 在暗藏32堵隐形墙的7×7棋盘上竞速抵达对角终点！每回合可上下左右移动3步（每人全场拥有2次“双倍机会”可连走6步）。一旦撞上隐形墙立即响起警报并退回起点重来，考验空间记忆与路线规划！
tagline.en: Race across a 7×7 grid hiding 32 invisible walls! Move 3 steps per turn (plus TWO 6-step 'Double Chances' per match). Cross an invisible wall and the siren blasts—sending you all the way back to Start while both players memorize the barrier!

rulesBrief.zh: 在暗藏32堵隐形墙的7×7棋盘上竞速抵达对角终点！每回合可上下左右移动3步（每人全场拥有2次“双倍机会”可连走6步）。一旦撞上隐形墙立即响起警报并退回起点重来，考验空间记忆与路线规划！ 胜负条件：First player to step onto their Goal square wins immediately.
rulesBrief.en: Race across a 7×7 grid hiding 32 invisible walls! Move 3 steps per turn (plus TWO 6-step 'Double Chances' per match). Cross an invisible wall and the siren blasts—sending you all the way back to Start while both players memorize the barrier! Win: First player to step onto their Goal square wins immediately.

tagline.zh: 改编自桌游《威尼斯连线》：起始放置2块相邻车站砖，轮流使用16块双面铁轨砖（正面直线、背面90°弯道），每回合须沿同一直线连续放置1–3块（至少1块紧邻已有砖块）。放完最后一块使全部已放砖块连成单一闭合环路者胜；或在己方回合宣告“不可能”，逼对手用剩余砖块拼出闭合环路，对手拼不出即宣告者胜！
tagline.en: Lay 1 to 3 double-sided track tiles (Straight / 90° Curve) per turn to build a single closed monorail loop connecting both sides of the Station. Place the final closing tile to win—OR declare 'IMPOSSIBLE!' to force your rival to prove a loop still exists!

tagline.zh: 《黑与白》终极进化版！双方各有0–9共10张砖（偶黑奇白）与30枚筹码。开局先在屏风后秘密排定10回合出牌顺序并把30枚筹码全部分配到10张砖下（每张至少1枚）。撤掉屏风后逐轮亮出筹码与黑白颜色：筹码少的一方选择跟注（须从已赢筹码或后续牌堆借调补齐，后续每格仍须留至少1枚）或弃牌（不亮数字直接输掉己方筹码）。10轮后筹码多者胜！
tagline.en: Behind a privacy screen, lock the exact play order of your 10 tiles (0–9: Even=Black, Odd=White) AND split 30 chips across all 10 slots (min 1 per slot). Drop the screen! Each round, the lower bettor must either FOLD or CALL by borrowing chips from future slots or winnings!

tagline.zh: A–P共16块翻板背面藏有数字1–12与4个运算符号（第4季版为 +, ×, ÷, √x+√y），开局全盘仅展示5秒！每轮随机抽出目标自然数，先按抢答器者在5秒内按“数字→符号→数字”顺序点出3个字母拼出目标值即得1分（用√x+√y得2分！），超时或答错则机会不限时转交对手，每轮结束后依序重显1块板3秒。先达10分胜！
tagline.en: You get just 5 SECONDS to memorize a 4×4 wall (A–P) hiding numbers 1–12 and 4 operators! When a Target Number drops, slam the buzzer and pick 3 letters (Number → Operator → Number) within 5 seconds to hit the exact target. First to 10 points wins!
